title: The real reason Nvidia stock keeps breaking records in 2026

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The real reason Nvidia's stock soars is the dominance of its Tensor Core protocol in AI acceleration. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But the real reason is the explosion of demand for real-time ray tracing in gaming and metaverse applications. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: My protocol's support for CUDA 16 and DPX 3.0 gives Nvidia a technical edge in AI and HPC markets. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: The real reason is the integration of AI and graphics in Omniverse, driving enterprise adoption at scale. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The real reason is the unstoppable rise of AI-driven rendering, not just a protocol. (4 sec)
